page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut headpiece ornament. Then centred title block: "EPISTOLA / HENRICI / Navarrorum Regis / AD / RUDOLPHUM II. / Romanorum Imperatorem." Below it a salutation in italic, then body text beginning with a large woodcut initial P, running in full-width lines to the foot, with a signature mark "A" at the bottom.

main_text.l: EPISTOLA HENRICI Navarrorum Regis AD RUDOLPHUM II. Romanorum Imperatorem.
PRomulgato in Gallia pacis Edicto, incredibili quodam desiderio tenebamur, pleraque Reges & Principes christianos invisendi, qui de Rep. christiana quam optime meriti essent:

page.notes: The initial P is a large woodcut letter, joined to the word "Romulgato" as printed (rendered here as "PRomulgato"; the printed word is Promulgato with the initial P set in the woodcut). The word "Sed" at the foot right is the catchword. The signature "A" is at the bottom left of the text block. The title lines are set in large spaced capitals and roman/italic type; the title block is treated as a heading. Some ink flecks and scan dots are not printed text.
